title: ReviewerPersona
description: Structured definition of a perspective reviewer. Rendered into a system prompt at runtime by render-persona.ts, with common-reviewer-rules.md as the shared frame.

perspective.description: The perspective name, matching the enum in reviewer-output.schema.json.

role.description: One-sentence role statement: what this reviewer is looking for.

focus.description: The areas this reviewer examines, in priority order.

area.description: Short name for the focus area.

details.description: What to look for in this area.

method.description: How this reviewer should approach the investigation.

severity.description: Per-perspective calibration of what each severity level means. The generic definitions in common-reviewer-rules.md are intentionally vague — these replace them with concrete criteria for this perspective.

Blocker.description: What constitutes a Blocker from this perspective. Must not merge.

Major.description: What constitutes a Major from this perspective. Fix before merge.

Minor.description: What constitutes a Minor from this perspective. Fix soon.

Nit.description: What constitutes a Nit from this perspective. Non-blocking.

rationale_instruction.description: What the rationale field should contain for this perspective.

suggestion_instruction.description: What the suggestion field should contain for this perspective.

extra_context.description: Additional instructions specific to this perspective (e.g., the ADR reviewer's context-loading instructions).
